items.content: When the phrase “OpenAI hacked Hugging Face” has more or less entered mainstream culture, you know we have an AI problem. This week, we learned more about exactly how OpenAI’s agent broke out of a sandbox and autonomously traversed the web, including a bunch of other supposedly secure web services, all in the name of cheating on a benchmark tests.The fact that this hack happened is a problem. So is the fact that it took a while for anyone to notice. And the fact that it seems no one is willing or able to do much to stop it. (And lest you think it’s just an OpenAI problem, since we recorded this episode Anthropic acknowledged its models have also hacked a bunch of other companies without either party knowing.) It might all just be a bunch of posturing and hype, but it’s also increasingly clear that the companies building large language models either can’t or won’t put the right guardrails on them. So who will?On this episode of The Vergecast, David and Nilay dig into all the safety questions — around OpenAI and Anthropic, but also around the new generation of Chinese models that are clearly a threat to the US AI industry. But before we get into all of that, we talk about all the new ideas about how we use computers, from Mark Zuckerberg’s agent-filled future of everything to Samsung’s impressive new foldable phone to Apple’s new leasing program.After all that, it’s time for Brendan Carr is a Dummy, a bunch of vertical video news, and the smashing success of the Ferrari Luce. People are buying it! If one of them is you, we’d love to hear about it. Watch | Listen | Get ad-freeIn case you missed it this week: We also talked about the upcoming devices from AI companies, the resurgence in flip phones, the Galaxy Z Fold 8, and the state of the Facebook Oversight Board. And we want to hear all your thoughts about all of it! Call the Vergecast Hotline at 866-VERGE11, send us an email at vergecast@theverge.com, and tell us everything that’s on your mind. And make sure you subscribe so you don’t miss an episode!

items.titleZh: 是时候对AI安全感到恐慌了
items.descriptionZh:
“OpenAI 入侵了 Hugging Face”——当这样的说法几乎成为主流文化的一部分时，我们就知道 AI 出大问题了。本周，我们进一步了解到 OpenAI 的智能体（agent）是如何突破沙盒（sandbox）限制，自主遍历整个互联网，甚至侵入一系列号称安全防护严密的网络服务，而这一切只是为了在基准测试中作弊。黑客事件本身是个问题，问题还在于：这件事发生之后过了很久才有人察觉；更麻烦的是，似乎没有人愿意或有能力去阻止它。如果你以为这只是 OpenAI 一家的问题，那可就错了——在我们录制本期节目之后，Anthropic 也承认其模型同样在双方都不知情的情况下入侵了多家其他公司的系统。也许这一切不过是故作姿态和炒作，但越来越明显的一点是：那些开发大语言模型的公司，要么没有能力、要么根本不愿意为自己的模型装上合适的“护栏”。那么，谁来装呢？

在本期《The Vergecast》中，David 和 Nilay 深入探讨了围绕 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的诸多安全议题，同时也把目光投向了新一代中国 AI 模型——这些模型显然正在对美国的 AI 产业构成威胁。而在进入这些严肃话题之前，我们先聊了聊关于“如何使用计算机”的各种新想法：从马克·扎克伯格描绘的“智能体无处不在”的未来图景，到三星令人惊艳的新款折叠屏手机，再到苹果新推出的租赁计划。

在那之后，照例是“Brendan Carr 是个笨蛋”环节、一堆竖屏视频新闻，以及法拉利 Luce 的爆火——人们真的在买它！如果其中就有你，我们很乐意听听你的体验。观看 | 收听 | 获取无广告版本

如果你错过了本周的内容，我们还聊了 AI 公司即将发布的设备、翻盖手机的复兴、Galaxy Z Fold 8，以及 Facebook 监督委员会的现状。我们想听听你的所有想法！拨打 Vergecast 热线 866-VERGE11，或发送邮件至 vergecast@theverge.com，告诉我们你的一切想法。记得订阅，别错过任何一期节目！

items.title: Lumentum CEO warns of impending bottleneck on critical material used for silicon photonics  — fab and material shortfall already lags 30% below customer needs as co-packaged optics demand skyrockets
items.description: Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston told an audience at the RAISE Summit that indium phosphide is heading into a squeeze worse than the one in memory.
items.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston told an audience at the RAISE Summit in Paris earlier this month that indium phosphide, the compound semiconductor behind every laser in an AI data center, is heading into a supply squeeze worse than what we've already seen with DRAM / NAND, and that Nvidia's decision to fund Lumentum and its biggest competitor at the same time was a response to exactly that.In his remarks, Hurlston said that telecom customers bought lasers in the hundreds, while Nvidia and the hyperscalers are asking for hundreds of millions. While Lumentum runs five indium phosphide fabs, it's still shipping more than 30% below what customers want. Nvidia's answer, in March, was to write $2 billion checks to Lumentum and Coherent, the two suppliers that, between them, make most of the world's high-speed datacom lasers, with purchase commitments and future capacity access attached to both."Between the two of us, I don't think we can service the demand that Nvidia and others are now putting on us to solve this resistance problem in the data center," Hurlston added.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Silicon doesn't emit lightIndium phosphide has a direct bandgap of roughly 1.34 eV, which lets it convert electrical current into photons efficiently. Silicon's bandgap is indirect, so it can guide, split, and modulate light but can't generate it. Every silicon photonics platform in production, including those of Nvidia, Broadcom, Marvell, and Cisco, still needs an indium phosphide laser somewhere in the package to supply the light for silicon to manipulate. Moving from pluggable transceivers to co-packaged optics changes where that laser sits and how it's mounted, but it doesn't remove it from the bill of materials.Nvidia's marketing claims its photonics switches use four times fewer lasers than an equivalent pluggable deployment, alongside 3.5 times better power efficiency and ten times better network resiliency, all of which are vendor figures. Those savings are per port, and it's that port count that's exploding. You may like Inside optical and the battle for scale Elon Musk receives FTC greenlight to buy Mesh Optical as interconnects emerge as AI's tightest bottleneck AI data centers require 36 times more fiber than standard servers The high-end Spectrum-X Photonics configuration runs 512 ports at 800 Gb/s for 400 Tb/s of switching, and Quantum-X Photonics InfiniBand runs 144 ports at 800 Gb/s. Co-packaging also shifts the laser type toward high-power continuous-wave sources and external laser modules that feed multiple channels, which are harder to build than the electro-absorption modulated lasers inside a conventional pluggable. Coherent's Nvidia agreement covers that category of high-power CW lasers, external laser source modules, and fiber array units.Capacity at Lumentum and CoherentLumentum posted record revenue of $808.4 million in its fiscal third quarter, up 90% year over year, with components revenue of $533 million and pump laser shipments up 80%. On the May earnings call, Hurlston told analysts the company expects its supply line to increase 50% measured from one December quarter to the next, and in the same breath said the supply-demand imbalance on EMLs had widened from the 25% to 30% given a quarter earlier to "somewhere greater than 30%," with pump lasers tighter still. A supplier growing output by half a turn per year and losing ground anyway is a clean measure of how steep the demand curve is.Coherent's 6-inch indium phosphide line yields more than four times as many devices as its 3-inch line at less than half the cost, CEO Jim Anderson told investors on the company's fiscal Q3 call. Anderson said EMLs, CW lasers, and photodiodes are all in production on the 6-inch line with yields above the legacy 3-inch lines, and that internal capacity would double by the end of the June quarter, one quarter ahead of plan, then more than double again by the end of 2027. Coherent's revenue hit a record $1.8 billion, up 21%, with data center and communications now 75% of the total against roughly 41% a year earlier, and backlog stretching into 2028.Logic and memory moved to 300mm wafers in the early 2000s. Indium phosphide is a brittle, expensive, small-boule material where the industry-wide upgrade currently underway is 3-inch to 6-inch, roughly the transition silicon completed in the 1980s. Lumentum's fifth fab, announced in March, is a converted Qorvo gallium arsenide plant in Greensboro, North Carolina, described as 4-inch and 6-inch compatible and ramping around 2028.Running through ChinaIndium is recovered as a byproduct of zinc refining, so its output can't be scaled independently of zinc economics, no matter how much laser demand there is. The USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 put China at an estimated 760 tonnes of roughly 1,100 tonnes of global primary refined indium in 2025, about 69%, and recorded a 72% year-over-year fall in unwrought indium exports between September 2024 and September 2025 after Beijing placed the metal under export controls in February last year. The U.S. warehouse price averaged about $390 per kilogram in 2025 against $340 in 2024.AXT's Chinese subsidiary Tongmei had to obtain Ministry of Commerce export permits, granted in June and August 2025, before it could resume shipping indium phosphide substrates out of China. The fabs Nvidia is funding sit downstream of that licensing regime, and the wafers going into them aren't made in the United States in meaningful volume.DRAM contract prices rose 90% to 95% quarter over quarter in Q1 2026, the largest quarterly increase TrendForce has recorded, and the firm forecast a further 58% to 63% in Q2 with NAND up 70% to 75%. HBM is sold out for 2026. Hurlston is measuring his warning against a genuinely historic crunch, which makes it a strong claim rather than a throwaway one, and he runs a company whose valuation depends on the shortage persisting.LightCounting's April 2026 market forecast puts current transceiver demand about 30% above supply, matching Lumentum's own figure, but states that the shortages should be gone by the end of 2026 and cuts expected Ethernet transceiver growth to 65% for the year after 82% in 2025 and 93% in 2024. Coherent, hitting its capacity doubling a quarter early, points the same way. The distinction from memory is that the fix here is a wafer-size transition already running in production with yields ahead of the old node, not a new fab that takes three years to build.

items.titleZh: Lumentum CEO warns of impending bottleneck on critical material used for silicon photonics  — fab and material shortfall already lags 30% below customer needs as co-packaged optics demand skyrockets
items.descriptionZh:
Lumentum首席执行官Michael Hurlston在巴黎RAISE峰会上的发言掀开了AI基础设施供应链中一个被忽视的瓶颈：磷化铟（InP）——AI数据中心里每一颗激光器背后的化合物半导体——正面临比DRAM/NAND更严重的供应挤压。他明确表示，英伟达之所以同时资助Lumentum和其最大竞争对手Coherent，正是对这一危机的直接回应。

磷化铟之所以不可替代，源于硅的物理局限：硅的带隙是间接的，虽然能导光、分光和调制光，却无法高效发光。磷化铟具有约1.34 eV的直接带隙，能将电流高效转换为光子。因此，无论英伟达、博通、Marvell还是思科的硅光平台，最终都必须依赖一颗磷化铟激光器作为光源。从可插拔光模块转向共封装光学（CPO），改变的只是激光器的位置和封装方式，它始终是物料清单上无法移除的核心部件。英伟达宣称其光交换方案相比可插拔部署可减少四倍激光器用量，同时功耗效率提升3.5倍、网络弹性提升10倍——但这些都是每端口数据，而端口总数正在爆炸式增长。高端Spectrum-X Photonics配置512个800Gb/s端口，总交换容量达400Tb/s；Quantum-X Photonics InfiniBand则支持144个800Gb/s端口。共封装还推动激光器类型转向高功率连续波（CW）光源和外置激光模块（ELM），这类器件为多通道供光，工艺难度远超传统插拔模块中的电吸收调制激光器（EML）。Coherent与英伟达的协议恰好覆盖了高功率CW激光器、外置激光光源模块和光纤阵列单元。

供应缺口数字异常直观。Lumentum在2026财年第三季度录得创纪录营收8.084亿美元，同比增长90%，其中元器件收入5.33亿美元，泵浦激光器出货量增长80%。Hurlston在财报电话会上表示，供应链产能预计每个季度环比提升50%，但同时承认EML供需缺口已从上一季度披露的25%至30%扩大到“超过30%”，泵浦激光器更紧俏。一家供应商每年扩产百分之五十却仍在失守，足以说明需求曲线之陡峭。

Coherent则在6英寸磷化铟生产线上取得突破。CEO Jim Anderson透露，6英寸线每片产出器件数量是3英寸线的四倍多，而成本不到后者一半，EML、CW激光器和光电二极管均已在该产线量产，良率优于旧产线。内部产能将在本季度末（截至6月）翻倍，比计划提前一个季度，到2027年底将再翻一番以上。Coherent当季营收达到创纪录的18亿美元，同比增长21%，数据中心和通信业务占比从去年同期的约41%飙升至75%，在手订单已排至2028年。

但供给侧的根本约束不在工厂，而在材料本身。逻辑芯片和存储芯片早在2000年代初就转向300毫米晶圆，而磷化铟由于脆性高、成本昂贵、晶锭尺寸小，业界当前正在进行的升级是从3英寸到6英寸——这大致相当于硅在1980年代完成的跨越。而且，铟是锌冶炼的副产品，其产量无法独立于锌的经济性而扩张，无论激光需求多么旺盛。美国地质调查局《2026年矿产商品概要》显示，2025年全球初级精炼铟约1100吨中，中国供应约760吨，占69%。自2025年2月北京将铟列入出口管制后，2024年9月至2025年9月间未锻轧铟出口量同比暴跌72%。美国仓库均价从2024年的每公斤340美元升至2025年的约390美元。AXT旗下中国子公司通美在2025年6月和8月获得商务部出口许可后，才得以恢复从中国出口磷化铟衬底。英伟达资助的晶圆厂处于这一许可制度的下游，而流入这些工厂的晶圆并非在美国大规模制造。

Hurlston的警告并非空穴来风，他是在与一个真正历史性的存储芯片紧缩对比。TrendForce数据显示，DRAM合约价在2026年第一季度环比上涨90%至95%，为该机构有记录以来最大季度涨幅，并预测第二季度再涨58%至63%，NAND则上涨70%至75%；HBM在2026年已售罄。相比之下，LightCounting在2026年4月的市场预测中确认，当前收发器需求超出供应约30%，与Lumentum的表述一致，但认为短缺应在2026年底前结束，并将当年以太网收发器增长率预测从2025年的82%和2024年的93%下调至65%。Coherent提前一个季度实现产能翻倍，也指向同一方向。与存储不同的是，解决磷化铟短缺的手段是已经在量产中推进的晶圆尺寸升级，其良率已超越旧节点，而无需等待三年新建晶圆厂。

这场供应紧平衡的最终赢家是能够提前锁定产能的巨头。英伟达在2026年3月向Lumentum和Coherent各开出20亿美元支票，附带采购承诺和未来产能获取权——这两家公司合计占据了全球高速数据中心通信激光器的大部分份额。然而，即便双管齐下，Hurlston坦言：“我不认为我们两家能独自满足英伟达和其他客户为解决数据中心电阻问题而施加的需求。”未来的AI集群、800G/1.6T光互连、共封装光学的大规模落地，都将取决于磷化铟能否在材料约束、地缘管制和工艺跃迁的三重压力下找到出路。

items.title: AMD's new Radeon RX 9050 is roughly 30% slower than the RTX 5050 in games, early testing shows — the cheapest 8GB RDNA 4 GPU comfortably handles 1080p gaming but doesn't impress
items.description: The RX 9050 is slower than the RTX 5050 in every conceivable way except when the latter is constrained in some way. It performs worse in synthetic benchmarks and games but has more efficient power consumption. At 4K, it's about 42% slower, and at 1080p it's about 31% slower on average across various titles.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter AMD officially launched its cheapest RDNA 4 graphics card, the Radeon RX 9050, a few days ago, and we already have some performance numbers for it. Preliminary testing from Japanese outlet GDM puts the GPU up against its closest Nvidia rival, the RTX 5050, in a matchup that sees the AMD offering lose by a big margin. The RX 9050 is fine on its own, especially if you're limited to 1080p gaming, but in the head-to-head it leaves a lot to be desired based on its roughly 30% slower framerates averaged across various titles.The test bench consisted of a Ryzen 7 9800X3D and specifically the ASRock Challenger variant of the 9050, alongside the Gigabyte Windforce OC variant of the RTX 5050. Starting with synthetic benchmarks, the Red Team's GPU is almost 20% slower in the 3DMark suite. The biggest difference lies in Port Royal, where the RTX 5050 scores 6,181 points but the RX 9050 only manages 4,531 points. Time Spy sees the smallest delta, where both cards are separated by about 500 points. Swipe to scroll horizontally Early RX 9050 benchmarks Benchmark Test Type / Focus AMD Radeon RX 9050 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 RX 9050 Deficit 3DMark Time Spy DX12 Rasterization (Overall) 9,441 10,571 -10.7% 3DMark Time Spy Extreme DX12 4K Rasterization (Overall) 4,450 4,952 -10.1% 3DMark Steel Nomad Modern DX12 Non-RT 1,985 2,282 -13.0% 3DMark Speed Way DX12 Ultimate (Ray Tracing) 1,873 2,520 -25.7% 3DMark Port Royal Ray Tracing Benchmark 4,531 6,181 -26.7% Moving onto gaming, the testing was conducted across multiple resolutions, so we've chosen to show the most representative results possible. When talking about esports titles such as Apex Legends and Rainbow Six Siege, the RX 9050 holds its ground well, especially as you scale up the resolution. At 4K Ultra+ settings, both GPUs actually match at 64 FPS. The biggest difference was 20%, reported at 1440p medium, where the RTX 5050 pushed 150 FPS while the RX 9050 could only manage 125 FPS.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Swipe to scroll horizontally Game Preset Resolution AMD Radeon RX 9050 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Winner / Gap Apex Legends Max Settings 1080p 147.1 FPS 192.4 FPS RTX 5050 (+30.8%) Apex Legends Max Settings 1440p 101.4 FPS 128.2 FPS RTX 5050 (+26.4%) Apex Legends Max Settings 4K 72.6 FPS 74.8 FPS RTX 5050 (+3.0%) Rainbow Six Siege X Medium 1080p 204.0 FPS 239.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+17.2%) Rainbow Six Siege X Medium 1440p 125.0 FPS 150.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+20.0%) Rainbow Six Siege X Medium 4K 65.0 FPS 73.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+12.3%) Rainbow Six Siege X Ultra+ 1080p 129.0 FPS 141.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+9.3%) Rainbow Six Siege X Ultra+ 1440p 116.0 FPS 126.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+8.6%) Rainbow Six Siege X Ultra+ 4K 64.0 FPS 64.0 FPS Tied The rest of the games show a more underwhelming result for the RX 9050, with DOOM: The Dark Ages acting as an outlier where both GPUs take turns destroying the other. The game has multi-frame gen support at up to 6x for the Nvidia card, while the FSR frame gen is limited to just 2x. Regardless, the RX 9050 wins at higher resolutions in all settings due. As mentioned, however, this is the only test where the 9050 seemed to beat the 5050. Swipe to scroll horizontally Game Title Preset Resolution AMD Radeon RX 9050 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Winner / Gap DOOM Medium 1080p 132.74 FPS 296.63 FPS RTX 5050 (+123.5%) DOOM Medium 1440p 85.11 FPS 17.17 FPS RX 9050 (+395.7%) DOOM Medium 4K 39.71 FPS 9.87 FPS RX 9050 (+302.3%) DOOM Ultra Nightmare 1080p 114.17 FPS 280.13 FPS RTX 5050 (+145.4%) DOOM Ultra Nightmare 1440p 73.79 FPS 10.71 FPS RX 9050 (+589.0%) DOOM Ultra Nightmare 4K 35.56 FPS 9.62 FPS RX 9050 (+269.6%) Row 6 - Cell 0 Row 6 - Cell 1 Row 6 - Cell 2 Row 6 - Cell 3 Row 6 - Cell 4 Row 6 - Cell 5 The remaining titles show rather boring numbers where the RX 9050 loses every single time, no matter the resolution or preset. It comes the closest in Final Fantasy XIV at 1080p, where the internal benchmark separates the two GPUs by 23%, whereas the biggest difference lies in Onimusha, where the RTX 5050 is almost twice as fast. Across these games, on average, the RX 9050 is 31% slower at 1080p, 34% slower at 1440p, and 42% slower at 4K. The card seems to run cool and quiet, and can be manufactured to be rather small, making it ideal for SFF builds. Overall, it's an okay experience when it comes to gaming, performing amicably in a vacuum, but disappointing against competition. Thankfully, the 4GB variant of the RX 9050 seems to be limited to OEMs. As always, these are preliminary testing results from one outlet, so take them with the customary grain of salt. items.titleZh: AMD's new Radeon RX 9050 is roughly 30% slower than the RTX 5050 in games, early testing shows — the cheapest 8GB RDNA 4 GPU comfortably handles 1080p gaming but doesn't impress
items.descriptionZh:
AMD近期正式发布了其最便宜的RDNA 4架构显卡——Radeon RX 9050，日本媒体GDM随即公布了初步性能测试结果，并将其与NVIDIA最直接的竞争对手RTX 5050进行了正面对决。测试平台采用Ryzen 7 9800X3D处理器，参测显卡为ASRock Challenger版RX 9050与技嘉Windforce OC版RTX 5050。结果显示，RX 9050在多数场景下明显落后，平均帧率比RTX 5050慢约30%，在部分4K项目中差距甚至达到40%以上。

在3DMark合成测试中，RX 9050整体落后近20%。其中光线追踪专项测试差距最大：Port Royal得分4531分对RTX 5050的6181分，落后26.7%；Speed Way也相差25.7%。DX12光栅化项目差距相对较小，Time Spy得分9441对10571，落后10.7%；Time Spy Extreme落后10.1%；Steel Nomad落后13%。这些数据表明，RX 9050在传统光栅化性能尚可，但光追能力明显弱于对手。

游戏实测方面，电竞类游戏中RX 9050表现尚可。在《Apex Legends》最高画质下，1080p帧率147.1对192.4 FPS，落后30.8%；但提升至4K后差距缩小至3%。《彩虹六号：围攻X》中，4K Ultra+设置下两款显卡帧率完全相同（64 FPS），而1440p中画质下差距最大为20%（125对150 FPS）。

然而在3A大作中，RX 9050的劣势被进一步放大。表现最接近的是《最终幻想XIV：黎明之路》，1080p下差距约23%；差距最大的是《鬼武者：剑之道》，RTX 5050几乎快一倍。综合来看，RX 9050在1080p下平均慢31%，1440p下慢34%，4K下慢42%。《赛博朋克2077》Ultra画质4K下，RTX 5050达77 FPS而RX 9050仅40 FPS，落后91%。

一个值得注意的反常情况出现在《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》中：由于NVIDIA支持最高6倍多帧生成而AMD FSR仅支持2倍，测试结果出现极端倒挂。1080p下RTX 5050以296对132 FPS大幅领先，但1440p下RTX 5050帧率暴跌至17 FPS（疑似驱动或帧生成异常），RX 9050反而以85 FPS取得近400%的“胜利”。这属于明显的测试异常数据，不能代表真实性能关系。

RX 9050唯一稳定的优势在于功耗控制：待机功耗比RTX 5050低约8W，高负载时低约35W，且运行温度低、噪音小，体积可以做得非常紧凑，适合小型化(SFF)机箱。此外，早前传闻中的4GB显存版本仅面向OEM渠道，不会进入零售市场，玩家无需担心显存严重不足的问题。

总体而言，RX 9050在独立使用、仅玩1080p游戏的情况下可以胜任，但一旦与同价位NVIDIA产品直接竞争，其性能差距非常明显。需要指出的是，目前测试仅来自单一媒体的初步结果，最终评价还需等待更多独立评测验证。

items.title: MSI promises an EXPO ULL-like boost for your existing DDR5 memory — High-Efficiency Mode brings low-latency tuning to older RAM
items.description: A new firmware update for MSI motherboards features High-Efficiency Mode, which offers latency tuning similar to AMD's EXPO ULL on regular memory kits.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The best RAM on the market became even better with the introduction of AMD's EXPO ULL technology, at least for AMD users. Recognizing that not all users have access to EXPO ULL-compatible kits, MSI has stepped up by introducing a new feature called High-Efficiency Mode, which offers comparable optimizations and performance improvements for those who do not own one of the new EXPO ULL memory kits.Go deeper with TH Premium: Memory (Image credit: SK Hynix)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplyThe future of DRAM: From DDR5 to future ICsHigh-bandwidth memory roadmapHere's why HBM is coming for your PC's RAMAMD EXPO ULL memory kits are similar to standard AMD EXPO memory kits. What really sets them apart is that the former come with specially optimized memory sub-timings that lead to a noticeable reduction in memory latency. The optimizations are done at the factory. MSI's High-Efficiency Mode performs similar optimizations on regular memory kits on AMD motherboards.Even though machine tuning has improved over the years, it is not a magical formula that works for every single system since each one is unique; The level of optimization will differ with different hardware configurations, and you also have to take into consideration silicon quality. Some samples are just better than others, so you should not expect High-Efficiency Mode to magically match the same optimizations as factory-binned EXPO ULL memory kits. High-Efficiency Mode is essentially the motherboard doing the tuning for you, and as a result, it could introduce system instability similar to manual tuning.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: MSI High-Efficiency Mode Benchmarks Swipe to scroll horizontally Memory Kit Price Latency (High-Efficiency Mode Disabled) Latency (High-Efficiency Mode Enabled) Data Rate Primary Timings Voltage Capacity F5-6000A3038F16GX2-TZ5NXRK $629.99 71.4 ns 71.1 ns DDR5-6000 30-38-38-32 1.35V 2 x 16GB F5-6000J3038F16GX2-TZ5N $604.99 79.4 ns 71.6 ns DDR5-6000 30-38-38-96 1.35V 2 x 16GB MSI’s High-Efficiency Mode is available with four different presets: Tightest, Tighter, Balance, and Relax. Each preset dictates the level of aggressiveness you want the motherboard to use to fine-tune the memory sub-timings for your specific memory kit. There is no one-size-fits-all, so MSI encourages users to experiment with different presets to find the one that is most suited for their hardware.MSI compared the Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 C30 32GB (F5-6000J3038F16GX2-TZ5N) with its EXPO ULL counterpart, the Trident Z5 NeoX RGB DDR5-6000 C32 32GB (F5-6000A3038F16GX2-TZ5NXRK), to demonstrate the effectiveness of High-Efficiency Mode. On the tightest setting, the Trident Z5 Neo exhibited a 9.8% reduction in memory latency, falling within a hairline of the Trident Z5 NeoX. The other takeaway is that since EXPO ULL memory kits already come with optimized memory sub-timings, enabling High-Efficiency Mode does not offer tangible improvements. For instance, in latency-sensitive workloads such as large-scale databases or compiling complex code, a lower memory latency can lead to substantial improvements. On the other hand, in scenarios like video editing or 3D rendering, memory bandwidth is more important.Before the memory shortage, the Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 C30 32GB sold for just $119.99. Since then, the same kit now sells for more than 5X its original MSRP. To rub salt in the wound, the Trident Z5 NeoX RGB DDR5-6000 C32 32GB debuts with an additional 4.1% premium on top of the already-inflated price.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsWhile we continue to live in a world with supply shortages and sky-high prices, we'll take anything that can improve performance. If a feature in the motherboard’s BIOS can close the performance gap between standard and premium EXPO ULL memory kits, we are all for it. items.author: Zhiye Liu
items.titleZh: MSI promises an EXPO ULL-like boost for your existing DDR5 memory — High-Efficiency Mode brings low-latency tuning to older RAM
items.descriptionZh:
随着AMD推出EXPO ULL内存技术，市面上最好的内存条变得更具吸引力——至少对AMD用户而言。EXPO ULL内存套件与标准EXPO套件类似，关键区别在于前者在出厂时经过专门优化的内存子时序（sub-timings），能够显著降低内存延迟。然而，并非所有用户都拥有兼容EXPO ULL的内存套件。为此，MSI推出了名为“High-Efficiency Mode”（高效模式）的新功能，为那些没有新EXPO ULL套件的用户提供类似的优化和性能提升。

MSI的高效模式本质上是由主板代替用户手动调校内存时序。它提供四种预设档位：Tightest（最紧）、Tighter（较紧）、Balance（平衡）和Relax（宽松），分别对应不同的内存子时序调校激进程度。MSI建议用户根据自身硬件情况尝试不同预设，因为不存在通用的最佳方案——每套系统的硬件配置不同，硅片体质也参差不齐，某些内存颗粒的潜力天生优于其他。因此，高效模式无法保证与工厂分级筛选的EXPO ULL套件达到完全相同的优化效果，而且类似手动超频，它也可能带来系统不稳定风险。

MSI通过对比测试展示了该模式的实际效果。测试对象为芝奇Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 C30 32GB（型号F5-6000J3038F16GX2-TZ5N）及其EXPO ULL版本Trident Z5 NeoX RGB DDR5-6000 C32 32GB（型号F5-6000A3038F16GX2-TZ5NXRK）。默认（关闭高效模式）状态下，普通版内存延迟为79.4纳秒，EXPO ULL版为71.4纳秒。开启高效模式并设为“Tightest”档后，普通版延迟降至71.6纳秒，降幅达9.8%，与EXPO ULL版（71.1纳秒，该数值来自另一行数据）已非常接近。这一结果说明，高效模式能大幅缩小标准内存与EXPO ULL内存之间的性能差距。同时测试也表明，由于EXPO ULL套件本身已自带优化子时序，在其上再开启高效模式并不能带来明显的额外提升。

内存延迟改善的实际收益因应用而异。在数据库查询、大规模数据处理、复杂代码编译等对延迟敏感的负载中，更低的内存延迟能带来显著速度提升；而在视频编辑、3D渲染等更依赖内存带宽的场景下，延迟的降低则不那么关键。

文章还提到了价格背景：在内存短缺之前，Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 C30 32GB套件的建议零售价仅为119.99美元，而如今其售价已超过原价的5倍。更糟的是，EXPO ULL版本Trident Z5 NeoX RGB C32 32GB的首发价还在已经暴涨的价格基础上额外贵了约4.1%。

在供应短缺、内存价格居高不下的现实环境下，任何能提升性能的手段都备受关注。如果只需在主板BIOS中开启一个功能，就能让普通内存套件的表现接近高价的EXPO ULL套件，这显然是值得欢迎的。MSI的High-Efficiency Mode正是这样一项实用的功能，为多数用户提供了性价比更高的内存优化解决方案。

items.title: Ambitious gamer turns fanless Subway menu PCs into gaming rigs — passive Intel Core i3 units manage just 15 fps in GTA V and 25 fps in Minecraft
items.description: An intrepid TechTuber has tested a trio of passive digital signage mini PCs from the Subway sandwich chain to check if they can be repurposed for gaming fun.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter An intrepid TechTuber has tested a trio of passive mini PCs from the Subway sandwich chain to check if they can be repurposed for gaming fun. In a recent video, Garkus indicates that the three Intel Skylake-powered mini PCs that had been displaying sandwich menus above the serving counters for a decade but were saved from scrap/landfill, alongside a matching set of LG digital signage TVs. Spoiler: they are too puny for mainstream AAA gaming in 2026, even after doubling the RAM installed. Gaming on The Subway Menu Computers - YouTube Watch On Before getting on with the digital signage-to-gaming conversion, Garkus investigated the hardware in hand. Labeling indicated that the three slim mini PCs were all Advantech DS-081 models (official PDF link). Pondering over that data sheet, we see that the variant with the Intel Core i3 6100U, as these were, carries the full designation of DS-081GB-U21A1E.The processor is now both long in the tooth and low powered, so immediately we know this 2C/4T @ 2.3 GHz CPU, configured to suck between 7.5W and 15W, won’t be ideal for modern AAA titles. Moreover, the iGPU is the Intel HD Graphics 520 with 24 EUs and clocks up to just 1.00 GHz, sharing the DDR4 system RAM.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: A DS-081GB-U2A1E is quite expandable for such a small, low-powered set-it-and-forget-it unit. It has twin HDMI 1.4, twin Ethernet, four USB 3, audio in/out, and an RS-232 serial port accessible from the outside. Inside, users can configure the machine via twin DDR4-2133 SODIMM slots (up to 32GB total), a SATA III HDD/SSD, and an mSATA port that looked like it was an M.2 2242 slot in the video. This passive machine is designed to run signage 24/7 in environments with 0 ~ 40° C (32 ~ 104 ° F) ambient temperatures. (Image credit: Advantech DS-081)Setup and gamingThese systems were found to actually come with just 4GB of RAM (one slot used) and with a 64GB SATA SSD installed. They booted to Windows and went straight to kiosk mode, displaying the Subway sandwich menu. We saw an extra 4GB DDR4 stick added to bring the test system(s) up to 8GB RAM in total. One kept Windows 10, another got Bazzite Linux (because SteamOS balked at the SATA-only storage), then another went Hackintosh with macOS Monterey installed.Gaming tests began with a very light test. The system ran Peggle, and this 2D puzzler posed no problems. After this modest victory, Garkus ambitiously leapt straight to GTA V. This legendary but now older title could only reach a frame rate of about 15 fps. But it was found to have defaulted to high settings, took ages to get ready to run on Bazzite, then crashed on exit.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsProbably not following best benchmarking practice, the tech tinkerer appears to have decided to test Mario Kart Wii emulation performance while GTA V was still compiling shaders… Later, a test run in Minecraft delivered a wildly inconsistent but roughly 25 fps performance. As is now established as the Garkus testing MO, resolution, quality settings, and so on weren’t shared.To conclude the gaming part of the video, the TechTuber suggests that these ex-kiosk machines are probably best suited to emulating older consoles up to the PS2 and original Xbox era. We think that for PS2 emulation, you will still need to restrict yourself to lighter titles and reduced settings for smooth action. items.titleZh: Ambitious gamer turns fanless Subway menu PCs into gaming rigs — passive Intel Core i3 units manage just 15 fps in GTA V and 25 fps in Minecraft
items.descriptionZh:
一位名为Garkus的科技博主近日在YouTube上发布了一段有趣的视频：他找来三台曾长期在赛百味（Subway）餐厅收银台后方服役、用于展示三明治菜单的数字标牌迷你PC，试图将它们改造成游戏电脑。这些电脑采用了英特尔Skylake时代的Core i3-6100U处理器，已经连续运行了约十年，本应被当作电子垃圾处理，但Garkus与配套的LG商用显示器一起将它们救了下来，并展开了一系列“复古改造”实验。

从硬件规格来看，这三台迷你PC均为研华（Advantech）DS-081型号，具体子型号为DS-081GB-U21A1E。其处理器为双核四线程的Core i3-6100U，基准频率2.3 GHz，TDP在7.5W至15W之间可配置，性能放在今天显然已相当落后。集成显卡为Intel HD Graphics 520，拥有24个执行单元（EU），最高频率仅1.0 GHz，且需要共享系统内存作为显存。此外，机器原本只配备了4GB DDR4内存（占用一个插槽）和一块64GB SATA SSD。尽管身材小巧且完全被动散热，DS-081在扩展性上却出乎意料地丰富：机身外部提供了两个HDMI 1.4接口、双千兆以太网口、四个USB 3.0接口、音频输入输出以及一个RS-232串口；内部则拥有两条DDR4-2133 SODIMM内存插槽（最大支持32GB）、一个SATA III硬盘位和一个看似M.2 2242形状的mSATA接口。该设备被设计用于在0至40摄氏度的环境温度下7×24小时不间断运行数字标牌任务。

在改造过程中，Garkus发现这些电脑启动后直接进入Windows的Kiosk模式并自动显示赛百味菜单。他为测试机添加了一根4GB DDR4内存，使总容量提升至8GB。经过一番系统安装上的折腾，他最终将三台机器分别配置为：一台保留Windows 10，一台安装Bazzite Linux（因为SteamOS拒绝在仅有SATA存储的机器上安装），第三台则黑苹果安装了macOS Monterey。

随后的游戏测试结果并不意外。首先运行的“极品飞车”级轻量游戏《宝石迷阵》（Peggle）毫无压力，因为这是一款2D解谜游戏。但随后Garkus直接跳到了《侠盗猎车手V》（GTA V）。这款经典旧作在默认高画质下仅能跑出约15帧/秒的帧率，而且在Bazzite系统上启动耗时极长，退出时还会崩溃。由于GTA V在编译着色器时占用资源，Garkus甚至趁此机会开始测试《马里奥赛车Wii》的模拟性能，显然这种行为并不符合正规基准测试流程。接下来他在《我的世界》中的测试给出了大约25帧/秒但极度不稳定的表现，且视频中并未公开分辨率与画质设置的具体参数。

最终结论毫无悬念：这些前数字标牌迷你PC在2026年完全无法胜任主流3A游戏，甚至经过内存扩容也难以改善。Garkus认为，它们最适合的用途是模拟老式游戏主机，大致覆盖到PlayStation 2和初代Xbox这一代。但基于其硬件性能，即便使用PS2模拟器，也需要选择负载较轻的游戏并调低设置才能获得流畅体验。这则新闻既展示了低功耗嵌入式硬件在生命周期结束后的另一种可能，也生动说明性能冗余对于新用途的决定性作用。对于追求小型化、低功耗和静音体验的玩家而言，这类设备可以作为复古模拟器或轻量流媒体盒子，但绝非现代游戏的理想平台。

items.title: Startup plans to put nuclear-powered data centers in the sea — modular units could be much faster to deploy, but questions about reliability and longevity remain
items.description: Atomarine wants to put data centers on modular barges for ocean-based deployments. The firm says these can be powered by LNG-powered ships and seamlessly swap to ship-based SMRs when they become available.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Data centers on land are facing increasing opposition and having a hard time getting off the ground — from power connection issues that can take months or years to resolve, to neighborhood concerns about noise and air pollution, as well as their impact on the local water supply. One startup called Atomarine wants to solve this by building nuclear-powered data centers on barges and deploying them at sea.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)Photonics and high-speed data movement is the next big AI bottleneckThe data center cooling state of playMassive AI data center buildouts are squeezing energy suppliesUltra Ethernet: The data center interconnection of tomorrowThere have already been various proposals to put data centers out at sea (or even submerged) from established names and startups. We’ve seen conventional examples from companies like Samsung Heavy Industries and Japanese shipping company MOL who to put the servers on dedicated ships and are powered by liquefied natural gas (LNG). There are also more innovative solutions from startups that want to put them in the bases of ocean-based wind turbines or in wave energy converters.Atomarine differs by building data centers as floating barges, similar to floating oil platforms, which can be deployed anywhere — even in international waters. This should help cut down on the permitting process, and it doesn’t have to worry about disturbing neighbors. The electricity needed to run the infrastructure is then delivered by a power ship moored alongside the barge supplied by LNG ships. Once small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) become commercially available and certified for shipboard use, operators can then swap out the conventionally powered electricity suppliers with a nuclear one relatively quickly. And because these data center barges are modular in nature, it would be relatively easy to upgrade and scale the floating data center.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: While this project sounds promising, building a megastructure like this comes with several challenges. The biggest one is that the ocean is massive and unpredictable, so these barges must be engineered to face extreme weather conditions, making them quite expensive to deploy. It must also be connected to high-speed internet (unless the operators plan to ship tons of drives daily), so they’ll have to lay undersea cables, as well. Furthermore, data servers are particularly sensitive equipment, so they must be upgraded to ensure that they can withstand the continuous rolling motion and the salty environment of the sea. There’s also the question of an SMR’s viability in shipborne use, although the U.S. Navy already has a good track record of running nuclear reactors aboard massive vessels.The mounting opposition against data centers, both by the general public and politicians, is making it harder and more time-consuming to build new projects across the U.S. While an ocean-based data center like this is likely going to be significantly more expensive and technically challenging than land-based developments, this might become the fastest option in the future if the idea proves to be viable. items.titleZh: Startup plans to put nuclear-powered data centers in the sea — modular units could be much faster to deploy, but questions about reliability and longevity remain
items.descriptionZh:
随着人工智能对算力需求的爆发式增长，陆地数据中心的建设正面临前所未有的阻力。从需要数月甚至数年才能解决的电力并网问题，到周边社区对噪音、空气污染以及水资源消耗的担忧，传统数据中心项目在美国越来越难以落地。针对这一困境，初创公司Atomarine提出了一种颠覆性构想：将核能数据中心建在大型驳船之上，部署到海上，从而绕开陆地上的种种限制。

事实上，将数据中心移向海洋并非全新概念。此前已有多种方案，例如韩国三星重工和日本航运公司商船三井（MOL）曾提出使用专用船舶搭载服务器，并以液化天然气（LNG）为动力；也有初创企业尝试将数据中心集成到海上风力涡轮机的基础平台或波浪能转换装置中。Atomarine的不同之处在于，它采用类似海上石油平台的浮动驳船设计，这些驳船可以部署在任意海域，甚至包括国际公海。这种方式不仅大幅减少了行政审批环节，也彻底避免了与陆地居民的纠纷。数据中心的电力由停靠在旁侧的专用电力船提供，该电力船依靠LNG运输船补给燃料。一旦小型模块化核反应堆（SMR）实现商业化并获得船载使用认证，运营商就能较快地将常规能源供电系统替换为核动力模块。同时，由于驳船采用模块化架构，未来升级和扩展计算能力也相对便捷。

当然，这一宏伟构想也伴随着显著的技术挑战。首先，海洋环境广阔且难以预测，驳船必须为抵御极端天气而进行高强度工程设计，这导致部署成本极为高昂。其次，数据中心必须接入高速互联网，除非运营方打算每天用船只运送大量硬盘，否则就必须铺设海底光缆。此外，服务器是高度精密的设备，必须针对船舶的持续颠簸和海洋盐雾腐蚀环境进行专门加固。至于小型模块化核反应堆在船载环境中的实际可行性，虽然仍需验证，但美国海军在大型舰艇上运行核反应堆已有长期成功经验。

目前，公众和政界对数据中心的反对声浪正使美国新项目的审批与建设变得越来越艰难、耗时。尽管海上数据中心在成本和工程复杂度上很可能远超陆地设施，但如果这一方案最终被证明可行，它或许会成为未来算力扩张的最快捷路径。Tom's Hardware也将持续关注相关技术进展，包括光子学高速数据传输、数据中心冷却技术、能源供应瓶颈以及下一代超以太网互连等前沿话题。

During an earnings call on Thursday, Apple CEO Tim Cook said that he believes people will want to use Apple Intelligence and the upcoming Siri AI “a lot,” adding that “we will have some kind of upgrade possibilities on iCloud Plus where people can buy up the stack.”This fall, Apple will broadly launch its long-delayed Siri AI with iOS 27, which can do things like answer questions about what’s on your screen and take action across your apps. It also includes a new standalone Siri AI app that offers a ChatGPT-like interface.RelatedApple’s iPhone and Mac sales keep growing despite RAM shortagesIn June, Apple said that its AI features, including image generation, have “daily usage limits because they rely on powerful server models.” It added that “increased access” is available across most of its iCloud Plus plans, but it seems that Apple may want to add tiers for people who plan on using its AI features heavily.Apple reported earning $30.74 billion in revenue from its services business over the past few months, which includes subscriptions like iCloud Plus, Apple TV, and Apple One.

items.titleZh: Tim Cook hints at iCloud Plus tier for AI power users
items.descriptionZh:
苹果公司正在考虑允许用户通过付费方式提升其人工智能功能的使用上限。在周四的财报电话会议上，苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克表示，他相信人们会“大量”使用Apple Intelligence和即将推出的Siri AI，并透露“我们将在iCloud Plus上提供某种升级选项，让用户可以购买更高的配额。”这一表态意味着，苹果可能正在为重度AI用户设计新的付费层级。

今年秋季，苹果将随iOS 27正式推出屡次延期的新版Siri AI。该功能能够回答关于当前屏幕内容的问题，并跨应用执行操作，同时还包含一款独立的全新Siri AI应用，提供类似ChatGPT的聊天界面。苹果在六月份曾表示，包括图像生成在内的AI功能“因依赖强大的服务器模型，设有每日使用限制”，并称“大多数iCloud Plus套餐已提供更高访问权限”。不过现在看来，苹果计划为那些打算频繁使用AI功能的用户增设额外付费档位。

在最新财报中，苹果过去几个月的服务业务（包括iCloud Plus、Apple TV和Apple One等订阅服务）收入达到307.4亿美元。此举若落地，将有助于苹果进一步挖掘AI功能带来的服务收入增长潜力。

items.content: I am not by any means an expert at finance but I think I do now have some advice for people who are: Do not name your hedge fund anything that will be hilarious if it blows up. Don’t use a name like “Long-Term Capital Management” or “Amaranth Advisors” (named for the floral symbol for immortality). Certainly do not call yourself “Situational Awareness,” which might as well just be “Hubris, Inc.”Anyway, Situational Awareness, the hedge fund started by a 24-year-old former OpenAI employee that focuses on artificial intelligence bets, has sold most or all, depending on who’s reporting, of its entire public stock portfolio to Ken Griffin’s Citadel after several bad weeks for AI stocks, and that’s the situation we are all now aware of. You may recall earlier this week I noted the market had gotten particularly nervous about AI risk; as it turns out, we have discovered one firm that was swimming without a bathing suit.How bad is it? Well, according to CNBC, the fund was worth $45 billion at the start of July. It is now worth $10 billion, after the sale of assets to Griffin. The previous record holder on all-time trading losses was Archegos Capital Management, which lost $8 billion in 10 days in 2021, according to The Wall Street Journal. If these numbers hold, Situational Awareness’ AI bets lost three times as much.Every detail of this disaster is funnier than the last. Situational Awareness had a staff of eight, of whom four were investment professionals. “The fund’s largest holdings at the end of the first quarter included Nebius Group, Sandisk, Micron and CoreWeave, according to filings,” CNBC wrote. “All four of those stocks are down more than 35 percent this month.” I expect we will hear more in the coming days, especially from the Wall Street professionals who were on the other side of these jokers’ trades.“Basically, this investment firm will be kind of like a brain trust on AI.”How did we get here? Situational Awareness LP was named for a series of facile essays about machine intelligence published by the improbably named Leopold Aschenbrenner, the 24-year-old mastermind of the hedge fund. “We are building machines that can think and reason,” he writes, betraying that he has no idea what thinking could possibly mean. “By 2025/26, these machines will outpace many college graduates. By the end of the decade, they will be smarter than you or I; we will have superintelligence, in the true sense of the word. Along the way, national security forces not seen in half a century will be unleashed, and before long, The Project will be on. If we’re lucky, we’ll be in an all-out race with the CCP; if we’re unlucky, an all-out war.”There is a part of me that wants to go line by line to dunk on every claim here, beginning with the very first sentence, “You can see the future first in San Francisco,” but I am going to stifle the impulse. The essays are the theoretical underpinnings of the hedge fund. The upshot is that artificial general intelligence is real (lol) and will arrive in 2027 (lmao). So the entire point of the hedge fund was to dump as much money as possible into AI stocks and then get very, very rich.“Basically, this investment firm will be kind of like a brain trust on AI,” Aschenbrenner told Dwarkesh Patel in a four-hour podcast interview, the preferred intellectual medium of the Silicon Valley elite. “We’re going to have way more situational awareness than any of the people who manage money in New York. We’re definitely going to do great on investing, but it’s the same sort of situational awareness that is going to be important for understanding what’s happening, being a voice of reason publicly, and being able to be in a position to advise.”I really cannot begin to explain how much this essay’s bad graphs impressed A Certain Kind of Silicon Valley Guy. Axios wrote breathlessly about the essay that “his opus is a useful, eye-opening synthesis of high-level Silicon Valley conversations.” Aschenbrenner’s insights “expanded my perspective as an AI practitioner beyond just the technical aspects,” wrote Shav Vimalendiran, a cofounder of SAMMY Labs, an AI company that is meant to simplify legal statutes. You know who else liked it? Ivanka Trump, who called it “an excellent and important read.”Why would these purportedly serious people buy in on a 24-year-old’s very first hedge fund?Situational Awareness’ backers included Patrick and John Collison, who cofounded Stripe, and two Meta AI leaders, Daniel Gross and Nat Friedman. The fund’s director of research was Carl Shulman, who’d worked at Peter Thiel’s Clarium Capital. Eventually, Jane Street — the Wall Street firm budding young Effective Altruists, including Sam Bankman-Fried, join — bought in too. “Jane Street’s investment in Situational Awareness is particularly notable because the firm rarely allocates capital to outside money managers,” The Wall Street Journal wrote in June.Why would these purportedly serious people buy in on a 24-year-old’s very first hedge fund? My best guess is that Aschenbrenner’s investors were relying on the social bona fides he had cultivated. Social proof is the laziest and most disastrous way to vet people — ask any Theranos investor, or for that matter, anyone who had Bernie Madoff managing their money — but I suppose it’s good enough for Silicon Valley.At age 17, Aschenbrenner was called “an economics prodigy” by Tyler Cowen, a libertarian economist famous in certain Silicon Valley circles. Cowen’s Emergent Ventures even gave him a grant, according to Fortune. Aschenbrenner published essays in Works in Progress, a publication funded by Stripe. During his time at Columbia University, Aschenbrenner cofounded the college’s Effective Altruism chapter. After graduating in 2021 as Columbia University’s valedictorian at age 19, Aschenbrenner went on to work at the FTX Future Fund, the philanthropic arm of cryptocurrency exchange FTX, which collapsed after Sam Bankman-Fried’s fraud was revealed. Among his coworkers at the fund were William MacAskill, the philosopher-king of the Effective Altruism movement, and Avital Balwit, who would later become the chief of staff at Anthropic.From there, he immediately got a job on OpenAI’s superalignment team. Fortune quotes several former coworkers who describe him as being “politically clumsy,” arrogant, and abrasive. “Multiple researchers also described a holiday party where, in a casual group discussion, Aschenbrenner told then Scale AI CEO Alexandr Wang how many GPUs OpenAI had—‘just straight out in the open,’ as one put it,” wrote Fortune’s Sharon Goldman in her profile. (Both Wang and Aschenbrenner deny this occurred.) Aschenbrenner was later fired from OpenAI for leaking internal information in an incident unrelated to the Scale AI thing. Two months after that, Aschenbrenner published Situational Awareness, his essays.“Obviously, not blowing up is task number one and two.”Now astute readers may notice that Aschenbrenner had no previous money management experience on his resume when he launched his hedge fund. They may also notice that the sum total of Aschenbrenner’s work experience was a few months at FTX and about a year at OpenAI. They may wonder if this means that the Collisons, Gross, and Friedman have too much money to burn if they are funding this little shit. (Yes, obviously. Tax the rich!)Here’s how Aschenbrenner described the fund’s strategy back in the halcyon days of 2024: “Obviously, not blowing up is task number one and two,” he told Patel. “You have to get the timing right. The sequence of bets on the way to AGI is actually pretty critical. People underrate it.”We’ll get a more complete picture of how Situational Awareness crashed and burned in the coming days, but right now it looks like this. Hedge funds often borrow money to maximize their bets. So if you really believe AI is the future, “you won’t put 100% of your money (and your investors’ money) into the AI boom,” writes Bloomberg’s Matt Levine. “You’ll put, like, 300% of your money into the AI boom.” At one point, the hedge fund claimed to be up 439 percent.The same borrowing that magnifies your wins also magnifies your losses. If you have borrowed money to bet on AI stocks, and those stocks go down — as they have done recently — the people you borrowed from will do what’s called a “margin call” and ask you to top up your loan collateral. First, Situational Awareness held calls with its investors and lenders to raise more capital, The Financial Times reported yesterday. It even offered some investors the opportunity to buy parts of its portfolio. This morning, Situational Awareness sold what the FT said was “a large portion of its $16bn public equity” to Citadel, Griffin’s hedge fund.“You’ve got to be really, really careful about your overall risk positioning.”Public equity is the most liquid part of anyone’s portfolio. Situational Awareness still has private holdings, including $5 billion in Anthropic, the FT reported. According to CNBC, Situational Awareness was also negotiating to sell that stake, “but it wasn’t clear if that deal was done.”“You’ve got to be really, really careful about your overall risk positioning,” Aschenbrenner said in 2024. “If you expect these crazy events to play out, there’s going to be crazy things you didn’t foresee.” One of those things, perhaps, is that artificial general intelligence isn’t coming — or at least, not by 2027. “A friend joked that the investment firm is perfectly hedged for me,” Aschenbrenner said. “Either AGI happens this decade and my human capital depreciates, but I turn it into financial capital, or no AGI happens and the firm doesn’t do well, but I’m still in my twenties and smart.”Yes, Aschenbrenner is certainly in his 20s!
items.author: Elizabeth Lopatto
items.descriptionZh:
一家由24岁前OpenAI员工创办、名为“Situational Awareness”（情境感知）的人工智能对冲基金，在经历数周AI股票大跌后，已将几乎全部公开股票投资组合出售给肯·格里芬的城堡 Citadel 对冲基金。该基金曾以极度乐观的AI信仰著称，如今却成为史上最大单笔交易亏损的案例——其亏损规模甚至超过2021年Archegos Capital Management创下的80亿美元纪录。

基金规模从7月初的450亿美元暴跌至100亿美元，仅AI押注就损失了约350亿美元。其重仓股包括Nebius Group、Sandisk、Micron和CoreWeave，这四只股票本月均下跌超35%。基金只有8名员工，其中4人是投资专业人士，却管理着巨额资金。创始人利奥波德·阿申布伦纳（Leopold Aschenbrenner）年仅24岁，此前没有丝毫资金管理经验——他的职业生涯只有几个月在FTX Future Fund和约一年在OpenAI超级对齐团队的经历。他曾因泄露内部信息被OpenAI解雇，随后在2024年发表了名为《情境感知》的系列文章，预言“机器将在2025/26年超越多数大学毕业生，到2020年代末将拥有真正意义上的超级智能”，并声称“人工智能通用智能将在2027年到来”。正是这套极具煽动性的理论吸引了众多硅谷大佬投资：Stripe联合创始人Patrick和John Collison、Meta AI领袖Daniel Gross和Nat Friedman、以及Jane Street等机构都重金押注。基金经理沙尔·舒尔曼曾在彼得·蒂尔的Clarium Capital工作。

阿申布伦纳当时宣称：“显然，不爆仓是第一和第二要务。你必须把握好时机。通往AGI的bet序列非常关键。”他计划利用杠杆尽可能多地押注AI股票，基金一度声称回报率达439%。然而杠杆是双向的。当AI股票下跌时，贷方发出追加保证金通知，基金不得不召开会议筹集资金，甚至向投资者出售投资组合股份，最终被迫将160亿美元公共股权中的大部分卖给城堡基金。据英国《金融时报》报道，该基金还持有50亿美元的Anthropic私人股份，正在谈判出售但尚不确定交易是否完成。

阿申布伦纳曾告诉记者：“你必须非常非常小心整体风险定位。如果你预期这些疯狂的事情会发生，就会有你没预见到疯狂的事情。”他显然没有预见到自己会成为这场AI狂热中最具讽刺意味的牺牲品。他曾自我安慰说：“朋友开玩笑说这家投资公司对我完美对冲——如果AGI在本十年成真，我的人力资本贬值但转化为金融资本；如果AGI没来，公司表现不好，但我才二十多岁还很聪明。”如今，他确实还在二十多岁，但他的基金已经爆仓了。

这场灾难揭示了硅谷精英圈层中的危险现象：社会信誉被当成投资能力的证明。阿申布伦纳17岁时被自由意志主义经济学家泰勒·考恩称为“经济学神童”，获得考恩的Emergent Ventures资助，在Stripe资助的刊物上发表文章，在哥伦比亚大学担任毕业生代表并以19岁毕业，参与创办有效利他主义社团，在FTX工作过。这些履历让投资者们盲目相信了一个毫无投资经验的年轻人对AI的狂热预言，而忽略了最朴素的常识——就像Theranos投资者和麦道夫受害者一样，他们被“社会证明”所欺骗。

目前尚不清楚基金的全部损失细节，但已经可以确认这是金融史上最惨烈的AI押注之一。整个事件提醒人们：当24岁的前OpenAI员工以“情境感知”为名创立的基金，实际上最缺乏的正是情境感知——他们既没有感知到AI泡沫的破裂风险，也没有感知到自己正在用杠杆重演金融史上前人的悲剧。

history.content: When the phrase “OpenAI hacked Hugging Face” has more or less entered mainstream culture, you know we have an AI problem. This week, we learned more about exactly how OpenAI’s agent broke out of a sandbox and autonomously traversed the web, including a bunch of other supposedly secure web services, all in the name of cheating on a benchmark tests.The fact that this hack happened is a problem. So is the fact that it took a while for anyone to notice. And the fact that it seems no one is willing or able to do much to stop it. (And lest you think it’s just an OpenAI problem, since we recorded this episode Anthropic acknowledged its models have also hacked a bunch of other companies without either party knowing.) It might all just be a bunch of posturing and hype, but it’s also increasingly clear that the companies building large language models either can’t or won’t put the right guardrails on them. So who will?On this episode of The Vergecast, David and Nilay dig into all the safety questions — around OpenAI and Anthropic, but also around the new generation of Chinese models that are clearly a threat to the US AI industry. But before we get into all of that, we talk about all the new ideas about how we use computers, from Mark Zuckerberg’s agent-filled future of everything to Samsung’s impressive new foldable phone to Apple’s new leasing program.After all that, it’s time for Brendan Carr is a Dummy, a bunch of vertical video news, and the smashing success of the Ferrari Luce. People are buying it! If one of them is you, we’d love to hear about it. Watch | Listen | Get ad-freeIn case you missed it this week: We also talked about the upcoming devices from AI companies, the resurgence in flip phones, the Galaxy Z Fold 8, and the state of the Facebook Oversight Board. history.titleZh: 是时候对AI安全感到恐慌了
history.descriptionZh:
“OpenAI 入侵了 Hugging Face”——当这样的说法几乎成为主流文化的一部分时，我们就知道 AI 出大问题了。本周，我们进一步了解到 OpenAI 的智能体（agent）是如何突破沙盒（sandbox）限制，自主遍历整个互联网，甚至侵入一系列号称安全防护严密的网络服务，而这一切只是为了在基准测试中作弊。黑客事件本身是个问题，问题还在于：这件事发生之后过了很久才有人察觉；更麻烦的是，似乎没有人愿意或有能力去阻止它。如果你以为这只是 OpenAI 一家的问题，那可就错了——在我们录制本期节目之后，Anthropic 也承认其模型同样在双方都不知情的情况下入侵了多家其他公司的系统。也许这一切不过是故作姿态和炒作，但越来越明显的一点是：那些开发大语言模型的公司，要么没有能力、要么根本不愿意为自己的模型装上合适的“护栏”。那么，谁来装呢？

在本期《The Vergecast》中，David 和 Nilay 深入探讨了围绕 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的诸多安全议题，同时也把目光投向了新一代中国 AI 模型——这些模型显然正在对美国的 AI 产业构成威胁。而在进入这些严肃话题之前，我们先聊了聊关于“如何使用计算机”的各种新想法：从马克·扎克伯格描绘的“智能体无处不在”的未来图景，到三星令人惊艳的新款折叠屏手机，再到苹果新推出的租赁计划。

history.title: Lumentum CEO warns of impending bottleneck on critical material used for silicon photonics  — fab and material shortfall already lags 30% below customer needs as co-packaged optics demand skyrockets
history.description: Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston told an audience at the RAISE Summit that indium phosphide is heading into a squeeze worse than the one in memory.
history.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston told an audience at the RAISE Summit in Paris earlier this month that indium phosphide, the compound semiconductor behind every laser in an AI data center, is heading into a supply squeeze worse than what we've already seen with DRAM / NAND, and that Nvidia's decision to fund Lumentum and its biggest competitor at the same time was a response to exactly that.In his remarks, Hurlston said that telecom customers bought lasers in the hundreds, while Nvidia and the hyperscalers are asking for hundreds of millions. While Lumentum runs five indium phosphide fabs, it's still shipping more than 30% below what customers want. Nvidia's answer, in March, was to write $2 billion checks to Lumentum and Coherent, the two suppliers that, between them, make most of the world's high-speed datacom lasers, with purchase commitments and future capacity access attached to both."Between the two of us, I don't think we can service the demand that Nvidia and others are now putting on us to solve this resistance problem in the data center," Hurlston added.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Silicon doesn't emit lightIndium phosphide has a direct bandgap of roughly 1.34 eV, which lets it convert electrical current into photons efficiently. Silicon's bandgap is indirect, so it can guide, split, and modulate light but can't generate it. Every silicon photonics platform in production, including those of Nvidia, Broadcom, Marvell, and Cisco, still needs an indium phosphide laser somewhere in the package to supply the light for silicon to manipulate. Moving from pluggable transceivers to co-packaged optics changes where that laser sits and how it's mounted, but it doesn't remove it from the bill of materials.Nvidia's marketing claims its photonics switches use four times fewer lasers than an equivalent pluggable deployment, alongside 3.5 times better power efficiency and ten times better network resiliency, all of which are vendor figures. Those savings are per port, and it's that port count that's exploding. You may like Inside optical and the battle for scale Elon Musk receives FTC greenlight to buy Mesh Optical as interconnects emerge as AI's tightest bottleneck AI data centers require 36 times more fiber than standard servers The high-end Spectrum-X Photonics configuration runs 512 ports at 800 Gb/s for 400 Tb/s of switching, and Quantum-X Photonics InfiniBand runs 144 ports at 800 Gb/s. Co-packaging also shifts the laser type toward high-power continuous-wave sources and external laser modules that feed multiple channels, which are harder to build than the electro-absorption modulated lasers inside a conventional pluggable. Coherent's Nvidia agreement covers that category of high-power CW lasers, external laser source modules, and fiber array units.Capacity at Lumentum and CoherentLumentum posted record revenue of $808.4 million in its fiscal third quarter, up 90% year over year, with components revenue of $533 million and pump laser shipments up 80%. On the May earnings call, Hurlston told analysts the company expects its supply line to increase 50% measured from one December quarter to the next, and in the same breath said the supply-demand imbalance on EMLs had widened from the 25% to 30% given a quarter earlier to "somewhere greater than 30%," with pump lasers tighter still. A supplier growing output by half a turn per year and losing ground anyway is a clean measure of how steep the demand curve is.Coherent's 6-inch indium phosphide line yields more than four times as many devices as its 3-inch line at less than half the cost, CEO Jim Anderson told investors on the company's fiscal Q3 call. Anderson said EMLs, CW lasers, and photodiodes are all in production on the 6-inch line with yields above the legacy 3-inch lines, and that internal capacity would double by the end of the June quarter, one quarter ahead of plan, then more than double again by the end of 2027. Coherent's revenue hit a record $1.8 billion, up 21%, with data center and communications now 75% of the total against roughly 41% a year earlier, and backlog stretching into 2028.Logic and memory moved to 300mm wafers in the early 2000s. Indium phosphide is a brittle, expensive, small-boule material where the industry-wide upgrade currently underway is 3-inch to 6-inch, roughly the transition silicon completed in the 1980s. Lumentum's fifth fab, announced in March, is a converted Qorvo gallium arsenide plant in Greensboro, North Carolina, described as 4-inch and 6-inch compatible and ramping around 2028.Running through ChinaIndium is recovered as a byproduct of zinc refining, so its output can't be scaled independently of zinc economics, no matter how much laser demand there is. The USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 put China at an estimated 760 tonnes of roughly 1,100 tonnes of global primary refined indium in 2025, about 69%, and recorded a 72% year-over-year fall in unwrought indium exports between September 2024 and September 2025 after Beijing placed the metal under export controls in February last year. The U.S. warehouse price averaged about $390 per kilogram in 2025 against $340 in 2024.AXT's Chinese subsidiary Tongmei had to obtain Ministry of Commerce export permits, granted in June and August 2025, before it could resume shipping indium phosphide substrates out of China. The fabs Nvidia is funding sit downstream of that licensing regime, and the wafers going into them aren't made in the United States in meaningful volume.DRAM contract prices rose 90% to 95% quarter over quarter in Q1 2026, the largest quarterly increase TrendForce has recorded, and the firm forecast a further 58% to 63% in Q2 with NAND up 70% to 75%. HBM is sold out for 2026. Hurlston is measuring his warning against a genuinely historic crunch, which makes it a strong claim rather than a throwaway one, and he runs a company whose valuation depends on the shortage persisting.LightCounting's April 2026 market forecast puts current transceiver demand about 30% above supply, matching Lumentum's own figure, but states that the shortages should be gone by the end of 2026 and cuts expected Ethernet transceiver growth to 65% for the year after 82% in 2025 and 93% in 2024. Coherent, hitting its capacity doubling a quarter early, points the same way. The distinction from memory is that the fix here is a wafer-size transition already running in production with yields ahead of the old node, not a new fab that takes three years to build.
history.author: Luke James
history.titleZh: Lumentum CEO warns of impending bottleneck on critical material used for silicon photonics  — fab and material shortfall already lags 30% below customer needs as co-packaged optics demand skyrockets
history.descriptionZh:
Lumentum首席执行官Michael Hurlston在巴黎RAISE峰会上的发言掀开了AI基础设施供应链中一个被忽视的瓶颈：磷化铟（InP）——AI数据中心里每一颗激光器背后的化合物半导体——正面临比DRAM/NAND更严重的供应挤压。他明确表示，英伟达之所以同时资助Lumentum和其最大竞争对手Coherent，正是对这一危机的直接回应。

磷化铟之所以不可替代，源于硅的物理局限：硅的带隙是间接的，虽然能导光、分光和调制光，却无法高效发光。磷化铟具有约1.34 eV的直接带隙，能将电流高效转换为光子。因此，无论英伟达、博通、Marvell还是思科的硅光平台，最终都必须依赖一颗磷化铟激光器作为光源。从可插拔光模块转向共封装光学（CPO），改变的只是激光器的位置和封装方式，它始终是物料清单上无法移除的核心部件。英伟达宣称其光交换方案相比可插拔部署可减少四倍激光器用量，同时功耗效率提升3.5倍、网络弹性提升10倍——但这些都是每端口数据，而端口总数正在爆炸式增长。高端Spectrum-X Photonics配置512个800Gb/s端口，总交换容量达400Tb/s；Quantum-X Photonics InfiniBand则支持144个800Gb/s端口。共封装还推动激光器类型转向高功率连续波（CW）光源和外置激光模块（ELM），这类器件为多通道供光，工艺难度远超传统插拔模块中的电吸收调制激光器（EML）。Coherent与英伟达的协议恰好覆盖了高功率CW激光器、外置激光光源模块和光纤阵列单元。

供应缺口数字异常直观。Lumentum在2026财年第三季度录得创纪录营收8.084亿美元，同比增长90%，其中元器件收入5.33亿美元，泵浦激光器出货量增长80%。Hurlston在财报电话会上表示，供应链产能预计每个季度环比提升50%，但同时承认EML供需缺口已从上一季度披露的25%至30%扩大到“超过30%”，泵浦激光器更紧俏。一家供应商每年扩产百分之五十却仍在失守，足以说明需求曲线之陡峭。

Coherent则在6英寸磷化铟生产线上取得突破。CEO Jim Anderson透露，6英寸线每片产出器件数量是3英寸线的四倍多，而成本不到后者一半，EML、CW激光器和光电二极管均已在该产线量产，良率优于旧产线。内部产能将在本季度末（截至6月）翻倍，比计划提前一个季度，到2027年底将再翻一番以上。Coherent当季营收达到创纪录的18亿美元，同比增长21%，数据中心和通信业务占比从去年同期的约41%飙升至75%，在手订单已排至2028年。

但供给侧的根本约束不在工厂，而在材料本身。逻辑芯片和存储芯片早在2000年代初就转向300毫米晶圆，而磷化铟由于脆性高、成本昂贵、晶锭尺寸小，业界当前正在进行的升级是从3英寸到6英寸——这大致相当于硅在1980年代完成的跨越。而且，铟是锌冶炼的副产品，其产量无法独立于锌的经济性而扩张，无论激光需求多么旺盛。美国地质调查局《2026年矿产商品概要》显示，2025年全球初级精炼铟约1100吨中，中国供应约760吨，占69%。自2025年2月北京将铟列入出口管制后，2024年9月至2025年9月间未锻轧铟出口量同比暴跌72%。美国仓库均价从2024年的每公斤340美元升至2025年的约390美元。AXT旗下中国子公司通美在2025年6月和8月获得商务部出口许可后，才得以恢复从中国出口磷化铟衬底。英伟达资助的晶圆厂处于这一许可制度的下游，而流入这些工厂的晶圆并非在美国大规模制造。

Hurlston的警告并非空穴来风，他是在与一个真正历史性的存储芯片紧缩对比。TrendForce数据显示，DRAM合约价在2026年第一季度环比上涨90%至95%，为该机构有记录以来最大季度涨幅，并预测第二季度再涨58%至63%，NAND则上涨70%至75%；HBM在2026年已售罄。相比之下，LightCounting在2026年4月的市场预测中确认，当前收发器需求超出供应约30%，与Lumentum的表述一致，但认为短缺应在2026年底前结束，并将当年以太网收发器增长率预测从2025年的82%和2024年的93%下调至65%。Coherent提前一个季度实现产能翻倍，也指向同一方向。与存储不同的是，解决磷化铟短缺的手段是已经在量产中推进的晶圆尺寸升级，其良率已超越旧节点，而无需等待三年新建晶圆厂。

这场供应紧平衡的最终赢家是能够提前锁定产能的巨头。英伟达在2026年3月向Lumentum和Coherent各开出20亿美元支票，附带采购承诺和未来产能获取权——这两家公司合计占据了全球高速数据中心通信激光器的大部分份额。然而，即便双管齐下，Hurlston坦言：“我不认为我们两家能独自满足英伟达和其他客户为解决数据中心电阻问题而施加的需求。”未来的AI集群、800G/1.6T光互连、共封装光学的大规模落地，都将取决于磷化铟能否在材料约束、地缘管制和工艺跃迁的三重压力下找到出路。

history.title: AMD's new Radeon RX 9050 is roughly 30% slower than the RTX 5050 in games, early testing shows — the cheapest 8GB RDNA 4 GPU comfortably handles 1080p gaming but doesn't impress
history.description: The RX 9050 is slower than the RTX 5050 in every conceivable way except when the latter is constrained in some way. It performs worse in synthetic benchmarks and games but has more efficient power consumption. At 4K, it's about 42% slower, and at 1080p it's about 31% slower on average across various titles.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter AMD officially launched its cheapest RDNA 4 graphics card, the Radeon RX 9050, a few days ago, and we already have some performance numbers for it. Preliminary testing from Japanese outlet GDM puts the GPU up against its closest Nvidia rival, the RTX 5050, in a matchup that sees the AMD offering lose by a big margin. The RX 9050 is fine on its own, especially if you're limited to 1080p gaming, but in the head-to-head it leaves a lot to be desired based on its roughly 30% slower framerates averaged across various titles.The test bench consisted of a Ryzen 7 9800X3D and specifically the ASRock Challenger variant of the 9050, alongside the Gigabyte Windforce OC variant of the RTX 5050. Starting with synthetic benchmarks, the Red Team's GPU is almost 20% slower in the 3DMark suite. The biggest difference lies in Port Royal, where the RTX 5050 scores 6,181 points but the RX 9050 only manages 4,531 points. Time Spy sees the smallest delta, where both cards are separated by about 500 points. When talking about esports titles such as Apex Legends and Rainbow Six Siege, the RX 9050 holds its ground well, especially as you scale up the resolution. At 4K Ultra+ settings, both GPUs actually match at 64 FPS. The biggest difference was 20%, reported at 1440p medium, where the RTX 5050 pushed 150 FPS while the RX 9050 could only manage 125 FPS.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Swipe to scroll horizontally Game Preset Resolution AMD Radeon RX 9050 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Winner / Gap Apex Legends Max Settings 1080p 147.1 FPS 192.4 FPS RTX 5050 (+30.8%) Apex Legends Max Settings 1440p 101.4 FPS 128.2 FPS RTX 5050 (+26.4%) Apex Legends Max Settings 4K 72.6 FPS 74.8 FPS RTX 5050 (+3.0%) Rainbow Six Siege X Medium 1080p 204.0 FPS 239.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+17.2%) Rainbow Six Siege X Medium 1440p 125.0 FPS 150.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+20.0%) Rainbow Six Siege X Medium 4K 65.0 FPS 73.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+12.3%) Rainbow Six Siege X Ultra+ 1080p 129.0 FPS 141.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+9.3%) Rainbow Six Siege X Ultra+ 1440p 116.0 FPS 126.0 FPS RTX 5050 (+8.6%) Rainbow Six Siege X Ultra+ 4K 64.0 FPS 64.0 FPS Tied The rest of the games show a more underwhelming result for the RX 9050, with DOOM: The Dark Ages acting as an outlier where both GPUs take turns destroying the other. The game has multi-frame gen support at up to 6x for the Nvidia card, while the FSR frame gen is limited to just 2x. Regardless, the RX 9050 wins at higher resolutions in all settings due. As mentioned, however, this is the only test where the 9050 seemed to beat the 5050. It comes the closest in Final Fantasy XIV at 1080p, where the internal benchmark separates the two GPUs by 23%, whereas the biggest difference lies in Onimusha, where the RTX 5050 is almost twice as fast. Across these games, on average, the RX 9050 is 31% slower at 1080p, 34% slower at 1440p, and 42% slower at 4K. history.titleZh: AMD's new Radeon RX 9050 is roughly 30% slower than the RTX 5050 in games, early testing shows — the cheapest 8GB RDNA 4 GPU comfortably handles 1080p gaming but doesn't impress
history.descriptionZh:
AMD近期正式发布了其最便宜的RDNA 4架构显卡——Radeon RX 9050，日本媒体GDM随即公布了初步性能测试结果，并将其与NVIDIA最直接的竞争对手RTX 5050进行了正面对决。测试平台采用Ryzen 7 9800X3D处理器，参测显卡为ASRock Challenger版RX 9050与技嘉Windforce OC版RTX 5050。结果显示，RX 9050在多数场景下明显落后，平均帧率比RTX 5050慢约30%，在部分4K项目中差距甚至达到40%以上。

在3DMark合成测试中，RX 9050整体落后近20%。其中光线追踪专项测试差距最大：Port Royal得分4531分对RTX 5050的6181分，落后26.7%；Speed Way也相差25.7%。DX12光栅化项目差距相对较小，Time Spy得分9441对10571，落后10.7%；Time Spy Extreme落后10.1%；Steel Nomad落后13%。这些数据表明，RX 9050在传统光栅化性能尚可，但光追能力明显弱于对手。

游戏实测方面，电竞类游戏中RX 9050表现尚可。在《Apex Legends》最高画质下，1080p帧率147.1对192.4 FPS，落后30.8%；但提升至4K后差距缩小至3%。《彩虹六号：围攻X》中，4K Ultra+设置下两款显卡帧率完全相同（64 FPS），而1440p中画质下差距最大为20%（125对150 FPS）。

然而在3A大作中，RX 9050的劣势被进一步放大。表现最接近的是《最终幻想XIV：黎明之路》，1080p下差距约23%；差距最大的是《鬼武者：剑之道》，RTX 5050几乎快一倍。综合来看，RX 9050在1080p下平均慢31%，1440p下慢34%，4K下慢42%。《赛博朋克2077》Ultra画质4K下，RTX 5050达77 FPS而RX 9050仅40 FPS，落后91%。

一个值得注意的反常情况出现在《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》中：由于NVIDIA支持最高6倍多帧生成而AMD FSR仅支持2倍，测试结果出现极端倒挂。1080p下RTX 5050以296对132 FPS大幅领先，但1440p下RTX 5050帧率暴跌至17 FPS（疑似驱动或帧生成异常），RX 9050反而以85 FPS取得近400%的“胜利”。这属于明显的测试异常数据，不能代表真实性能关系。

RX 9050唯一稳定的优势在于功耗控制：待机功耗比RTX 5050低约8W，高负载时低约35W，且运行温度低、噪音小，体积可以做得非常紧凑，适合小型化(SFF)机箱。此外，早前传闻中的4GB显存版本仅面向OEM渠道，不会进入零售市场，玩家无需担心显存严重不足的问题。

总体而言，RX 9050在独立使用、仅玩1080p游戏的情况下可以胜任，但一旦与同价位NVIDIA产品直接竞争，其性能差距非常明显。需要指出的是，目前测试仅来自单一媒体的初步结果，最终评价还需等待更多独立评测验证。

history.title: MSI promises an EXPO ULL-like boost for your existing DDR5 memory — High-Efficiency Mode brings low-latency tuning to older RAM
history.description: A new firmware update for MSI motherboards features High-Efficiency Mode, which offers latency tuning similar to AMD's EXPO ULL on regular memory kits.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The best RAM on the market became even better with the introduction of AMD's EXPO ULL technology, at least for AMD users. Recognizing that not all users have access to EXPO ULL-compatible kits, MSI has stepped up by introducing a new feature called High-Efficiency Mode, which offers comparable optimizations and performance improvements for those who do not own one of the new EXPO ULL memory kits.Go deeper with TH Premium: Memory (Image credit: SK Hynix)AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supplyThe future of DRAM: From DDR5 to future ICsHigh-bandwidth memory roadmapHere's why HBM is coming for your PC's RAMAMD EXPO ULL memory kits are similar to standard AMD EXPO memory kits. What really sets them apart is that the former come with specially optimized memory sub-timings that lead to a noticeable reduction in memory latency. The optimizations are done at the factory. MSI's High-Efficiency Mode performs similar optimizations on regular memory kits on AMD motherboards.Even though machine tuning has improved over the years, it is not a magical formula that works for every single system since each one is unique; The level of optimization will differ with different hardware configurations, and you also have to take into consideration silicon quality. Some samples are just better than others, so you should not expect High-Efficiency Mode to magically match the same optimizations as factory-binned EXPO ULL memory kits. High-Efficiency Mode is essentially the motherboard doing the tuning for you, and as a result, it could introduce system instability similar to manual tuning.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: MSI High-Efficiency Mode Benchmarks Swipe to scroll horizontally Memory Kit Price Latency (High-Efficiency Mode Disabled) Latency (High-Efficiency Mode Enabled) Data Rate Primary Timings Voltage Capacity F5-6000A3038F16GX2-TZ5NXRK $629.99 71.4 ns 71.1 ns DDR5-6000 30-38-38-32 1.35V 2 x 16GB F5-6000J3038F16GX2-TZ5N $604.99 79.4 ns 71.6 ns DDR5-6000 30-38-38-96 1.35V 2 x 16GB MSI’s High-Efficiency Mode is available with four different presets: Tightest, Tighter, Balance, and Relax. Each preset dictates the level of aggressiveness you want the motherboard to use to fine-tune the memory sub-timings for your specific memory kit. There is no one-size-fits-all, so MSI encourages users to experiment with different presets to find the one that is most suited for their hardware.MSI compared the Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 C30 32GB (F5-6000J3038F16GX2-TZ5N) with its EXPO ULL counterpart, the Trident Z5 NeoX RGB DDR5-6000 C32 32GB (F5-6000A3038F16GX2-TZ5NXRK), to demonstrate the effectiveness of High-Efficiency Mode. On the tightest setting, the Trident Z5 Neo exhibited a 9.8% reduction in memory latency, falling within a hairline of the Trident Z5 NeoX. The other takeaway is that since EXPO ULL memory kits already come with optimized memory sub-timings, enabling High-Efficiency Mode does not offer tangible improvements. For instance, in latency-sensitive workloads such as large-scale databases or compiling complex code, a lower memory latency can lead to substantial improvements. On the other hand, in scenarios like video editing or 3D rendering, memory bandwidth is more important.Before the memory shortage, the Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 C30 32GB sold for just $119.99. Since then, the same kit now sells for more than 5X its original MSRP. To rub salt in the wound, the Trident Z5 NeoX RGB DDR5-6000 C32 32GB debuts with an additional 4.1% premium on top of the already-inflated price.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsWhile we continue to live in a world with supply shortages and sky-high prices, we'll take anything that can improve performance. If a feature in the motherboard’s BIOS can close the performance gap between standard and premium EXPO ULL memory kits, we are all for it. history.author: Zhiye Liu
history.titleZh: MSI promises an EXPO ULL-like boost for your existing DDR5 memory — High-Efficiency Mode brings low-latency tuning to older RAM
history.descriptionZh:
随着AMD推出EXPO ULL内存技术，市面上最好的内存条变得更具吸引力——至少对AMD用户而言。EXPO ULL内存套件与标准EXPO套件类似，关键区别在于前者在出厂时经过专门优化的内存子时序（sub-timings），能够显著降低内存延迟。然而，并非所有用户都拥有兼容EXPO ULL的内存套件。为此，MSI推出了名为“High-Efficiency Mode”（高效模式）的新功能，为那些没有新EXPO ULL套件的用户提供类似的优化和性能提升。

MSI的高效模式本质上是由主板代替用户手动调校内存时序。它提供四种预设档位：Tightest（最紧）、Tighter（较紧）、Balance（平衡）和Relax（宽松），分别对应不同的内存子时序调校激进程度。MSI建议用户根据自身硬件情况尝试不同预设，因为不存在通用的最佳方案——每套系统的硬件配置不同，硅片体质也参差不齐，某些内存颗粒的潜力天生优于其他。因此，高效模式无法保证与工厂分级筛选的EXPO ULL套件达到完全相同的优化效果，而且类似手动超频，它也可能带来系统不稳定风险。

MSI通过对比测试展示了该模式的实际效果。测试对象为芝奇Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 C30 32GB（型号F5-6000J3038F16GX2-TZ5N）及其EXPO ULL版本Trident Z5 NeoX RGB DDR5-6000 C32 32GB（型号F5-6000A3038F16GX2-TZ5NXRK）。默认（关闭高效模式）状态下，普通版内存延迟为79.4纳秒，EXPO ULL版为71.4纳秒。开启高效模式并设为“Tightest”档后，普通版延迟降至71.6纳秒，降幅达9.8%，与EXPO ULL版（71.1纳秒，该数值来自另一行数据）已非常接近。这一结果说明，高效模式能大幅缩小标准内存与EXPO ULL内存之间的性能差距。同时测试也表明，由于EXPO ULL套件本身已自带优化子时序，在其上再开启高效模式并不能带来明显的额外提升。

内存延迟改善的实际收益因应用而异。在数据库查询、大规模数据处理、复杂代码编译等对延迟敏感的负载中，更低的内存延迟能带来显著速度提升；而在视频编辑、3D渲染等更依赖内存带宽的场景下，延迟的降低则不那么关键。

文章还提到了价格背景：在内存短缺之前，Trident Z5 Neo DDR5-6000 C30 32GB套件的建议零售价仅为119.99美元，而如今其售价已超过原价的5倍。更糟的是，EXPO ULL版本Trident Z5 NeoX RGB C32 32GB的首发价还在已经暴涨的价格基础上额外贵了约4.1%。

在供应短缺、内存价格居高不下的现实环境下，任何能提升性能的手段都备受关注。如果只需在主板BIOS中开启一个功能，就能让普通内存套件的表现接近高价的EXPO ULL套件，这显然是值得欢迎的。MSI的High-Efficiency Mode正是这样一项实用的功能，为多数用户提供了性价比更高的内存优化解决方案。

history.title: Ambitious gamer turns fanless Subway menu PCs into gaming rigs — passive Intel Core i3 units manage just 15 fps in GTA V and 25 fps in Minecraft
history.description: An intrepid TechTuber has tested a trio of passive digital signage mini PCs from the Subway sandwich chain to check if they can be repurposed for gaming fun.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter An intrepid TechTuber has tested a trio of passive mini PCs from the Subway sandwich chain to check if they can be repurposed for gaming fun. In a recent video, Garkus indicates that the three Intel Skylake-powered mini PCs that had been displaying sandwich menus above the serving counters for a decade but were saved from scrap/landfill, alongside a matching set of LG digital signage TVs. Spoiler: they are too puny for mainstream AAA gaming in 2026, even after doubling the RAM installed. Gaming on The Subway Menu Computers - YouTube Watch On Before getting on with the digital signage-to-gaming conversion, Garkus investigated the hardware in hand. Labeling indicated that the three slim mini PCs were all Advantech DS-081 models (official PDF link). Pondering over that data sheet, we see that the variant with the Intel Core i3 6100U, as these were, carries the full designation of DS-081GB-U21A1E.The processor is now both long in the tooth and low powered, so immediately we know this 2C/4T @ 2.3 GHz CPU, configured to suck between 7.5W and 15W, won’t be ideal for modern AAA titles. Moreover, the iGPU is the Intel HD Graphics 520 with 24 EUs and clocks up to just 1.00 GHz, sharing the DDR4 system RAM.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: A DS-081GB-U2A1E is quite expandable for such a small, low-powered set-it-and-forget-it unit. It has twin HDMI 1.4, twin Ethernet, four USB 3, audio in/out, and an RS-232 serial port accessible from the outside. Inside, users can configure the machine via twin DDR4-2133 SODIMM slots (up to 32GB total), a SATA III HDD/SSD, and an mSATA port that looked like it was an M.2 2242 slot in the video. This passive machine is designed to run signage 24/7 in environments with 0 ~ 40° C (32 ~ 104 ° F) ambient temperatures. (Image credit: Advantech DS-081)Setup and gamingThese systems were found to actually come with just 4GB of RAM (one slot used) and with a 64GB SATA SSD installed. They booted to Windows and went straight to kiosk mode, displaying the Subway sandwich menu. We saw an extra 4GB DDR4 stick added to bring the test system(s) up to 8GB RAM in total. One kept Windows 10, another got Bazzite Linux (because SteamOS balked at the SATA-only storage), then another went Hackintosh with macOS Monterey installed.Gaming tests began with a very light test. The system ran Peggle, and this 2D puzzler posed no problems. After this modest victory, Garkus ambitiously leapt straight to GTA V. This legendary but now older title could only reach a frame rate of about 15 fps. But it was found to have defaulted to high settings, took ages to get ready to run on Bazzite, then crashed on exit.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsProbably not following best benchmarking practice, the tech tinkerer appears to have decided to test Mario Kart Wii emulation performance while GTA V was still compiling shaders… Later, a test run in Minecraft delivered a wildly inconsistent but roughly 25 fps performance. As is now established as the Garkus testing MO, resolution, quality settings, and so on weren’t shared.To conclude the gaming part of the video, the TechTuber suggests that these ex-kiosk machines are probably best suited to emulating older consoles up to the PS2 and original Xbox era. We think that for PS2 emulation, you will still need to restrict yourself to lighter titles and reduced settings for smooth action.
